name: BeesState
meaning: state field of Bees

name: BEES_ST_HOVER_HIVE
meaning: SetState 0: anim STAND, computes the camera angle to the hive; Update 0 waits for the hive to be in view (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_QUESTION_IN
meaning: SetState 1: anim INTERRO (question-mark reaction start); Update: on anim end -> 2 (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_QUESTION_LOOP
meaning: SetState 2: anim INTERRO2 looped for 3x the duration of anim 4; Update: timer -> 3 (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_QUESTION_OUT
meaning: SetState 3: anim INTERRO3; Update: on anim end msg 0x3e04 to the hit hive, flies to the second hive (0xe) (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_EXCLAIM_IN
meaning: SetState 4: anim EXCLAM; Update: on anim end -> 5 (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_EXCLAIM_LOOP
meaning: SetState 5: anim EXCLAM2 looped; Update: timer -> 6 (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_EXCLAIM_OUT
meaning: SetState 6: anim EXCLAM3; Update: on anim end msg 0x3e04 and -> 0xe (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_IN_HIVE
meaning: SetState 7: anim STAND2 looped, msg 0x3e03 to the mother hive; Update: sits at the mother hive (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_ENTER_HIVE
meaning: SetState 8: anim STAND2 once; Update: on anim end msgs 0x3e02/0x3e03 and -> 7 (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_ORBIT_HIVE
meaning: SetState 9: buzz sound 0x141, anim STAND, orbit anchor 0x50 from the hive; Update: orbits, -> 0xa at the mother hive (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_ORBIT_MOTHER
meaning: SetState 0xa: anim STAND, orbit anchor; Update: one full orbit (0xfff) of the mother hive, then 8 (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_ORBIT_SAM
meaning: SetState 0xb: anim STAND, orbit anchor 0x64; Update: orbits Sam until 0x2ffd, then 0xc (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_RETURN_HOME
meaning: Update 0xc: after the timer flies back to the mother hive at 400 u/s, then 7 (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_FLY_TO_TARGET
meaning: SetState 0xd: target = hive position; Update: flies to targetPos, then 9 (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_FLY_TO_HIVE
meaning: SetState 0xe: target = hive; Update: flies to the hive (sets g_beesLeftFirstHive), msg 0x3e02, then 9 (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_CHASE_SAM
meaning: SetState 0xf: buzz 0x141, anim STAND; Update: follows Sam or the honey-pot victim (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_CHASE_WOLF
meaning: SetState 0x10: anim STAND; Update: flies at the Wolf at 0x514 u/s, 0x11 on contact, 0xd if he is in water (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_STING_WOLF
meaning: SetState 0x11: anim STAND, MSG_ENTER_CD to the Wolf; Update: sticks to the Wolf's head (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_STING_VICTIM
meaning: SetState 0x12: buzz 0x141; Update: sits on the victim, msg 0x4a to it when alert == 3 (inferred)

name: BEES_ST_REACT
meaning: SetState 0x13: anim OUT (alert 0) or STAND2 for animDuration; Update: timer -> 0xf (inferred)
